## Strategy
The successful artifact enumerates Pieri extensions in the \(q^r\)-box, \(q=i+p\), \(r=j+c\), and checks
\[
h_1x_0=x_1+y_1,\quad h_2x_0=\gamma+z+y_2,
\]
\[
h_1x_1=\gamma+x_2+z,\quad h_1y_1=z+y_2+\theta,
\]
with \(\gamma=0\) for \(p=1\) and \(\theta=0\) for \(c=1\). It also checks the stated doubly-boundary matrix and determinant.

## Gaps
This is a finite computation over the recorded 225 parameter tuples; it does not prove these identities for all parameters or establish the parent theorem.
